ios.desc:
XSpeak is your live AI companion for every meeting. It transcribes conversations in real time, identifies speakers, shows relevant facts, answers questions, and structures the discussion as it happens. When it ends, your notes are already done.

Everything runs on your device. No accounts. No bots. No data collection. Your conversations stay yours.

Key features:
- Real-time transcription: follow every word as it's spoken. XSpeak works as a live recorder and notetaker, so you never miss what was said.
- Voice recognition: XSpeak knows which words are yours and which belong to others, so AI insights and analysis are personalized for you.
- Speaker identification: know who said what. Name a speaker once, and XSpeak recognizes them going forward.
- Live AI insights: as you talk, XSpeak brings up relevant facts, helps answer questions, and keeps the discussion structured. All in real time.
- Meeting minutes: when the meeting ends, your full transcript is ready. Run AI analysis to get a summary, insights, or suggestions in seconds.
- Playback: replay any moment to hear exactly what was said.
- Meeting history: revisit notes and insights from any past conversation.
- Custom AI skills: tell XSpeak what to watch for, and it tracks it in every meeting.
- Your choice of AI model: Apple Foundation Model or a custom model.
- Folders: organize conversations into folders to keep your library structured.
- Search: find any past conversation by name, or search through the full content of what was said.
- Automatic text replacements: set your own rules to replace specific fragments in the transcript automatically as they appear.
- Live translation: follow the conversation in real time, in the language you prefer.

Works for any conversation: one-on-ones, client calls, interviews, team standups, lectures, coaching sessions, and more.

Stay in the conversation. XSpeak handles the rest.

quotes.text:
Only Mac and iPad with M-series chip

Hi all, I'm Dimi, the author of XSpeak (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/xspeak-ai-meeting-assistant/id6748146688).

It is a fully on-device meeting companion that helps you follow conversations, spot what matters or what you might miss, respond with confidence, and get the most out of every meeting.

I started building it to help a close friend who often went through stressful meetings and would talk them through with me afterward, asking for support, validation, and advice. We once joked about how great it would be if I could attend with them. That's when the idea for XSpeak was born: a real-time, on-device meeting companion that stays by your side.

XSpeak is special in the following ways:

- 100% on-device, no accounts, no data collected.

- It shows meeting transcription in real time with speaker separation: you can see what you said and what others said.

- It uses on-device AI to analyze the transcript and deliver insights and suggestions when you need them.

Real-time transcription is free. AI analysis requires a subscription ($3.99/Month, $19.99/Year) with a 7-day free trial to experience all features.

You can try it out by installing it from the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/xspeak-ai-meeting-assistant/id6748146688

If you activate the free trial, don't forget to cancel the subscription if you don't need it later.

I'd love to hear what you think.
